title: Data — Health & Capacity
description: Current Postgres and Redis health. Live reads are independent of the selected time range. Expand diagnostics for tables, sessions and server details.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Total on-disk size of the finance_assistant database.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Backends currently connected (Used) out of max_connections (Max).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Used", current_setting('max_connections')::int AS "Max" FROM pg_stat_activity

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Shared-buffer hit ratio for this database. Below ~99% means the working set no longer fits.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(100.0 * blks_hit / NULLIF(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 1), 100) AS value FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()

panels.title: Replica lag
panels.description: Largest replay lag across connected standbys, in seconds. Zero means caught up.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(max(extract(epoch FROM replay_lag))), 0) AS value FROM pg_stat_replication

panels.title: Used memory
panels.description: used_memory from INFO memory.

panels.title: Connected clients
panels.description: connected_clients from INFO clients.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: keyspace_hits / (keyspace_hits + keyspace_misses) since the last restart. Misses are expected for token and idempotency lookups that are not present.

targets.query: eval "local i = redis.call('info','stats') local h = tonumber(string.match(i,'keyspace_hits:(%d+)')) or 0 local m = tonumber(string.match(i,'keyspace_misses:(%d+)')) or 0 if h + m == 0 then return 0 end return math.floor(h * 100 / (h + m))" 0

panels.title: Evicted keys
panels.description: evicted_keys from INFO stats. Non-zero means maxmemory is being hit.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the primary last started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - pg_postmaster_start_time()) AS value

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Cumulative deadlocks since the primary started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT deadlocks AS value FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()

panels.title: Tables — rows, size, scans
panels.description: Every user table with live/dead tuple counts, total and index size, scan counts and last vacuum.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT schemaname AS "Schema",
       relname AS "Table",
       n_live_tup AS "Rows",
       n_dead_tup AS "Dead",
       pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS "Size",
       pg_indexes_size(relid) AS "Indexes",
       seq_scan AS "Seq scans",
       idx_scan AS "Idx scans",
       to_char(last_vacuum, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Last vacuum"
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Outbox events by status. A growing PENDING count means the publisher is behind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       to_char(min(created_at), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Oldest",
       to_char(max(created_at), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Newest"
FROM finance.outbox_events
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Non-idle backends, longest first. Look here for idle-in-transaction and lock waits.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pid AS "PID",
       usename AS "User",
       state AS "State",
       wait_event_type AS "Wait type",
       wait_event AS "Wait",
       round(extract(epoch FROM now() - state_change)) AS "Seconds",
       left(query, 90) AS "Query"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY "Seconds" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Unused indexes
panels.description: Indexes with zero scans since the last statistics reset, largest first. Candidates for removal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT schemaname AS "Schema",
       relname AS "Table",
       indexrelname AS "Index",
       idx_scan AS "Scans",
       pg_relation_size(indexrelid) AS "Size"
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE idx_scan = 0
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(indexrelid) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Settings
panels.description: The settings that explain most performance behaviour. server_version and shared_buffers are the first to check.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Setting", setting AS "Value", unit AS "Unit", short_desc AS "Description"
FROM pg_settings
WHERE name IN (
    'server_version', 'max_connections', 'shared_buffers', 'work_mem',
    'maintenance_work_mem', 'effective_cache_size', 'max_wal_size',
    'min_wal_size', 'wal_level', 'max_wal_senders', 'max_replication_slots',
    'autovacuum', 'autovacuum_naptime', 'checkpoint_completion_target',
    'random_page_cost'
)
ORDER BY name

panels.title: Total keys
panels.description: DBSIZE on the primary.

panels.title: Ops / sec
panels.description: instantaneous_ops_per_sec from INFO stats.

panels.title: Expired keys
panels.description: expired_keys from INFO stats: keys removed by TTL, not by eviction.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: uptime_in_seconds from INFO server.

panels.title: refresh_token:*
panels.description: Number of keys matching refresh_token:*, counted server-side.

panels.title: user_tokens:*
panels.description: Number of keys matching user_tokens:*, counted server-side.

panels.title: idem:*
panels.description: Number of keys matching idem:*, counted server-side.

panels.title: finance:*
panels.description: Number of keys matching finance:*, counted server-side.

panels.title: token_blacklist:*
panels.description: Number of keys matching token_blacklist:*, counted server-side.

options.content:
Each panel runs `EVAL "return #redis.call('keys','<prefix>*')" 0` and shows the integer.

KEYS is O(N) and blocks the server while it runs. That is fine for the ~10k keys this homelab holds; do not reuse these panels against a much larger dataset — switch to SCAN there.

Totals: `DBSIZE` in the row above.

panels.description: Per-database key and expiry counts (INFO keyspace).

panels.description: role, connected_slaves and replication offsets (INFO replication).

panels.description: version, mode, uptime and process details (INFO server).
